content: Rust fuzzing practice (rust-fuzz book, Trail of Bits Testing Handbook): cargo-fuzz + libfuzzer-sys; structure-aware fuzzing via the arbitrary crate derive or via fuzz_mutator!, with reported evidence that mutator-based fuzzing gives better coverage growth than Arbitrary-based generation. Harness guidance: the code under test must be a library crate; seed the corpus with real files; use the init parameter of fuzz_target! for one-time setup; keep the harness assertion-bearing rather than a bare parse call. Bad harnesses discard the return value, run with a tiny -max_len that never reaches the interesting length fields, have no seed corpus, and are never run in CI.
